title: Derived completion computes infinitesimal punctured-spectrum cohomology
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, let $M$ be a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and put $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus\{\mathfrak m\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\mathcal F=\widetilde M|_U$ be the associated sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Work in the ordinary derived category $D(A)$ of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For an ideal $K$, put $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x\in N:K^r x=0\text{ for some }r\geq0\}$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], and write $R\Gamma_K$ for its right derived functor and $H_K^j(M)=H^j(R\Gamma_K(M[0]))$. Write $L^{\wedge_I}=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n)$ for derived $I$-adic completion: the derived tensor is computed using a K-flat resolution, and the derived inverse limit [def-weil-derived-limit] using the mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on the termwise products of a complex-level model of the tower. Use these derived-functor models and their natural completion maps, not arbitrary maps between abstract choices of cones. Write $R\Gamma(U,-)$ for derived global sections of Zariski module sheaves [pqf-def-cohomology]. For every integer $i$ there is a canonical isomorphism $H^i((R\Gamma(U,\mathcal F))^{\wedge_I})\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}H^i(U,\widetilde{M/I^nM}|_U)$. It is natural in $M$ and is induced by reduction maps; its composite with the completion map from $H^i(U,\mathcal F)$ has $n$th coordinate the map induced by $M\to M/I^nM$. Negative Zariski cohomology groups are understood to be zero. Moreover, for every open $V\subseteq U$ there is likewise a canonical isomorphism $H^0((R\Gamma(V,\mathcal F|_V))^{\wedge_I})\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\Gamma(V,\widetilde{M/I^nM}|_V)$ (for $V=U$ the one above with $i=0$), natural in $M$, whose composite with the completion map from $\Gamma(V,\mathcal F|_V)$ has $n$th coordinate the map induced by $M\to M/I^nM$; for opens $V'\subseteq V\subseteq U$ these isomorphisms carry $H^0$ of the completed restriction map $(R\Gamma(V,\mathcal F|_V))^{\wedge_I}\to(R\Gamma(V',\mathcal F|_{V'}))^{\wedge_I}$ to the limit of the restriction maps.

source.place: Tag 0DXI, lemma-compare-with-derived-completion, applied to the restriction of the sheaf associated to a finite module; its proof uses Tag 0DX1 (lemma-ML-local) and Tag 0A0K (lemma-derived-completion-pseudo-coherent). The degree-zero clause for an open V of U is the same proof on V (Tags 0BLX, lemma-formal-functions-general, and 0D60, cohomology-lemma-RGamma-commutes-with-Rlim), where the R^1lim term involves H^{-1}=0 and no Mittag-Leffler input is needed.
